reviews.text: I enjoy this foundation I found that it gives a natural look . I personally have been having issues with it not lasting all day but I believe that’s just a me thing . But u really enjoy the formulation. I wouldn’t recommend for some with dry skin to use this without prepping the skin. I have dry skin but I found that this foundation looks good as long as you make sure do your skin prep beforehand
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢個粉底，覺得佢俾到自然嘅妝感。我個人就遇到佢撐唔到成日嘅問題，但我相信呢個只係我嘅問題。不過我真係好鍾意佢嘅配方。乾性肌嘅人如果冇做好打底，我唔建議用。我係乾性肌，但只要事先做好保養，呢個粉底望落都幾好。

reviews.text: After being disappointed by etude house double lasting foundation re-formulation, i was looking for a new daily foundation that was lightweight, medium coverage, and natural. I love this foundation, it looks and feels so natural while providing some coverage for blemish scars! i hardly feel like i have to touch up at the end of the day and i don't need to cake on powder to keep it on... only complaint is that it has a very strong fragrance that lingers
reviews.zh: 對 etude house 雙效持久粉底改版失望之後，我就一直喺搵新嘅日常粉底，要夠輕薄、中度遮瑕、夠自然。我好鍾意呢個粉底，望落同感覺都好自然，仲可以遮到暗瘡印！到一日完結都幾乎唔需要補妝，唔使狂拍粉去維持妝容⋯⋯唯一投訴係佢有股好強烈嘅香味，而且持續好耐。

reviews.text:
This won't be a repurchased product. I have large pores, and this foundation seemed to highlight them even more. I tried applying this product in many different ways (spatula, sponge, brush, etc); however, no matter the method, my skin felt dry and the foundation was very cakey. It seemed to emphasize all my imperfections. 

This foundation might work better if you already have close to flawless skin.
reviews.zh:
唔會再回購呢個產品。我毛孔粗大，呢個粉底好似仲要將佢哋放大。我試過用好多唔同方法上妝（粉刮、美妝蛋、掃等等），但無論用咩方法，塊面都覺得乾，而且粉底好厚重。佢好似將我所有瑕疵都放晒出嚟。

如果你本身已經接近完美肌，呢個粉底可能會啱用啲。

reviews.text: The foundation gives a slight glowy finish and helps to brighten the skin. It is very lightweight yet long-lasting. You can apply a thin layer and build up coverage if required. It adheres to the skin really well and doesn't cake up. It gives a very natural finish that you can’t even tell that you are wearing foundation! I apply this after my routine skincare and it doesn’t feel drying at all. I find that it is best applied with a spatula which gives an even and smooth application, before blending it off with a sponge for that natural finish. There is a slight pleasant fragrance which I noticed when I first used it, but subsequently after using it for a few weeks, I don’t notice it that much anymore. The packaging is very luxurious and the bottle itself has a unique shape.
reviews.zh: 呢支粉底有少少水光妝效，可以幫助提亮膚色。質地好輕透但好持久。可以薄薄塗一層，需要嘅時候再疊加遮瑕度。佢好貼膚，唔會卡粉。個妝感好自然，自然到你根本睇唔出有塗粉底！我喺平時護膚程序之後用佢，一啲都唔覺得乾。我發現用刮棒上妝效果最好，可以上得均勻又平滑，再用美妝蛋推開就會有好自然嘅妝感。第一次用嘅時候有聞到少少好聞嘅香味，但用咗幾星期之後就冇乜點聞到喇。包裝好奢華，支樽嘅形狀都好特別。

reviews.text: I have very light skin that's neutral (both silver and gold don't look bad on me) but leans more towards the cool side. The #21 Ivory is a good shade that doesn't have too much yellow or pink in it and is light enough that when I apply it, it doesn't look like I have a bruise on my face lol (my bf commented that when I tried the Il Makige one). It's very light and hydrating, yet leaves a powdery, waterproof, and super durable finish, as long as you apply it when your skincare is partially absorbed. You can layer it, but I like the appearance of my skin peeking through for a more natural look. It's especially good with the Picasso spatula! I hate feeling like there's something on my face, and this is light with enough coverage to feel really natural!
reviews.zh: 我膚色好淺，係中性調（戴銀飾同金飾都唔會顯得唔夾），但偏冷調少少。#21 Ivory 呢個色號幾好，唔會太黃又唔會太粉，夠淺所以搽上面嘅時候唔會望落好似塊面瘀咗咁 lol（我試 Il Makige 嗰陣我男朋友就咁講過）。質地好輕又好保濕，但係喺護膚品半吸收嘅狀態下上妝，妝效會係帶有粉感、防水同超級持久。可以疊加，但我自己鍾意保留少少自己皮膚透出嚟嘅感覺，睇落會自然啲。配搭 Picasso 刮棒用特別正！我好怕塊面有嘢笠住，呢支夠輕又有足夠遮瑕度，望落好自然！

reviews.text:
Man I’m so sad I bought the wrong color lol, I got 22 hoping the shade would be more similar to my neck/body. I usually use a more yellow 21 (ex. Espoir’s be glow ivory), but my neck is somewhere between 22-23. I got this in 22, but it’s too pink/orange and not as dark as I expected. Not sure if that’ll show in the pics, but I tried T_T. 
Other than the color tho, this is the best foundation I’ve ever tried. If you like something that applies super easily and thinly and is semi-matte, you’ll prly like this. Wish it wasn’t so heavily scented tho, I could see this being headache-inducing if you’re sensitive to that kind of thing.
reviews.zh:
天呀我買錯色真係好sad lol，我揀咗 22，本來希望個色會接近我條頸同身體嘅顏色。我平時用偏黃嘅 21（例如 Espoir 嘅 be glow ivory），但我條頸大概係 22-23 之間。我買咗 22，但係太粉／太橙，仲有冇預期中咁深。唔知相睇唔睇得出，但我就盡咗力 T_T。
撇除顏色嘅問題，呢個係我用過最好嘅粉底。如果你鍾意嗰種超易上妝、薄薄透透又係半霧面嘅質地，你好大機會會鍾意。不過有少少遺憾係香味太重，如果你對香味敏感嘅話，用呢支可能會頭痛。

reviews.text: Firstly, I was disappointed that OY did not provide the foundation brush that I believe came with Hince foundations from reviews and checking on the official Hince website. Secondly, the foundation made my skin break out a bit after wearing it for a day. I have clear skin and nothing really causes breakouts, so this was another thing that disappointed me. However, the packaging is quite beautiful and it stayed on pretty well. Overall, I would just note the cons before purchasing, but it is a high-quality item that I may recommend depending on what one's skin type is.
reviews.zh: 首先，我好失望 OY 冇跟埋支粉底刷，我睇過其他 review 又去過 Hince 官網查過，本來應該係有送嘅。其次，我戴咗一日之後皮膚爆咗少少瘡。我本身皮膚都好乾淨，幾乎冇嘢會令我爆瘡，所以呢樣嘢真係令我好失望。不過包裝的確好靚，持久度都幾好。整體嚟講，我只係想提一提大家注意呢啲缺點先再決定買唔買，但呢件嘢嘅質素係高嘅，視乎你嘅膚質，我都可能會推薦。

reviews.text: I've been eyeing this foundation for a long time now and I'm really glad I got it, it's really comfortable on the skin. I saw that some people didn't like the smell but I personally don't mind it. Perfect if you're looking for light coverage but you can build it up. I had a lot of trouble choosing my shade but I went with #24 and I think its a pretty solid match, though 23 still would of worked for me. For reference I use the shade 301 from the moonshot range!
reviews.zh: 我觀望呢支粉底好耐喇，終於買到真係好開心，喺皮膚上面好舒服。我見過有啲人唔鍾意個味道，但我自己就覺得冇乜所謂。如果你想搵一支輕薄遮瑕度嘅粉底就啱晒，可以慢慢疊加。我揀色號揀咗好耐，最後揀咗 #24，覺得都幾夾，不過 #23 應該都仲啱我。畀大家一個參考，我用 moonshot 嘅 301 色號！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
